protocol.selection: Minimum mean next-observation prediction error on fixed development probes; no task outcomes.
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final update only; all choices sealed before task evaluation.

audit.scope: Frozen source/checkpoint identities, consumed steps, all real probe labels via scalar observation/transition replay, predictive selection, every final game trajectory via scalar dynamics, continued checkpoint lineage, and recorded action probabilities. No independent gradient replay.

limitations: Authored observation features, one foraging mechanism, two learner seeds; internal rewards and predictive selection remain objectives. No objective-free or open-ended improvement claim.
